goal: Prevent false eviction of valid BIP68 transactions and their descendants from the mempool during reorgs
Ensure relative locktimes are accurately re-evaluated when a chain reorg lowers the tip or median time past
agreement: Broad support with all concerns addressed and no open objections
Verified the fix prevents stale-lockpoint evictions and passes regression tests (Bortlesboat, tumutech)
Confirmed recalculation covers mixed inputs and time-based variants (ismaelsadeeq, DevaanshPathak)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes false eviction of valid transactions and their descendants during reorgs
Protects transaction propagation and second-layer protocols relying on relative timelocks
